bio: Treat yourself to a traditional Afternoon Tea in Millie's Lounge at The Ned. Set in the grand banking hall, this stylish restaurant offers a unique Afternoon Tea experience.  Afternoon Tea is served in the grand banking hall where guests can admire the iconic Grade I listed building.  Their menu includes a decadent selection of finger sandwiches, scones and cakes, paired with a wide range of teas. Guests can also choose to upgrade with a glass of Thienot Champagne alongside their Afternoon Tea for £63 per person.  Millie's Lounge is located at The Ned in the City of London. It is right beside Bank Station, and not far from London Cannon Street train station.
